That works and it's clear. Picking "design" with a tap and then typing the exclude shortcut landed on the same three links, with the two ways sitting together without feeling cluttered — the label buttons up top, the typed box right there, and one honest count of what I ended up with. I could tell they were cooperating on one result, not running two separate searches.

So yes: the click choices and the typed shortcut combine cleanly, and the screen stays readable rather than crowded. This is a good way to have both on hand.
